Both images also show external medical hardware, specifically ECG monitoring leads positioned on the chest wall, which are common artifacts in a clinical setting and do not interfere with the interpretation of the underlying pulmonary structures. These normal radiographs are clinically valuable as they help narrow down a differential diagnosis by excluding major thoracic pathologies.
